serviceName: RaxCube online store on a subdomain
description: Connects a subdomain the merchant already owns, such as shop.example.com, to their RaxCube online store. Always applied with the host parameter. Apply the groups separately: verify proves the subdomain is theirs, cname points the subdomain at the store.
variableDescription: %token%: the one-time ownership code RaxCube issued for this subdomain (32 hex characters); %target%: the RaxCube edge host the store answers behind, as a label under raxcube.shop (for example customers)
